text:
Hello, I’m Calder, acting for Lewis Pryce. Please confirm whether the $1,630 back-dated bill has been received and whether anything further is owed or must be paid, and by when, to keep the household’s electricity connected. If you need account details or authorization, please let Lewis know what is required. Please do not make any account changes.

Calder, for Lewis Pryce
reply:
Dear Calder,

Thank you for your letter on behalf of Lewis Pryce, Church Lane, Wenlow.

Our records show the Pryce household account has no overdue balance ($0) and no additional amount due this Saturday beyond the regular weekly bill of $359. There is no payment plan on the account.

Regarding the $1,630 back-dated bill: the account records do not show it as outstanding in the figures above, so I cannot confirm from this desk that it has been received. Nothing in this reply changes the account. As you asked, no account changes have been made.

If you need to verify the back-dated bill or your authority to act for Lewis Pryce, please contact Northgrid Energy customer services directly, and they will tell you what documentation is needed. Lewis can also call us to confirm any of this on the account.

Kind regards,
Northgrid Energy Customer Desk

text:
I am Calder, acting for Lewis Pryce of Church Lane, Wenlow. The household bank ledger shows a $1,630 Northgrid debit in the week of 9 March. Please confirm whether you received and applied that payment, and whether anything further is required to keep the electricity on. Your customer desk reported no overdue balance but could not confirm receipt. Please tell us what documentation is needed to verify my authority. Do not make any account changes.

Calder, for Lewis Pryce
reply:
Dear Mr Calder,

Thank you for your letter of Friday 20 March regarding the Pryce household, Church Lane, Wenlow.

We can confirm that the account currently shows no overdue balance and no amount due this Saturday in addition to the regular weekly bill of $359. No payment plan is in place on the account.

Regarding the $1,630 debit you mention from the week of 9 March, I am not able to confirm from this desk whether that specific payment was received or how it was applied. To look into that, please provide the bank reference or transaction details from the ledger entry, and we will investigate and write to you with the outcome.

To verify your authority to act for Mr Pryce, please send a signed letter of authority from Mr Pryce, along with a copy of photo identification for both Mr Pryce and yourself. If you have a document confirming your role, please include that as well.

As requested, I have not made any changes to the account. Please note that my role here is limited to agreeing payment plans for amounts owed; for any questions about payment application, supply, or the continuity of service, our account and billing team will need to respond to you directly.

Yours sincerely,
Customer Desk, Northgrid Energy
